## DAILY OPTIMIZATION WORKFLOWS

This topic is internal practitioner guidance. Daily optimization should protect signal quality and business alignment, not create noise through constant intervention.

### Daily Review
- Check disapprovals, broken destinations, tracking health, pacing anomalies, and bid strategy warnings.
- Review whether the latest performance move aligns with conversion delay, known promos, seasonality, or recent changes.
- Escalate only when the movement is material enough to matter to the business.

### Weekly Review
- Audit search terms, negative coverage, landing page performance, asset combinations, and conversion-goal settings.
- Review bid strategy reports before changing targets or budgets.
- Document one or two highest-confidence actions instead of making many low-signal changes.

### Monthly Review
- Revisit business goals, margin/LTV guardrails, geo or category priorities, and experiment roadmap.
- Reassess attribution fit, value quality, and whether the account is optimizing toward the right business outcome.

### Operating Rules
- Do not use preset asset or query thresholds as universal rules.
- Do not optimize to Quality Score averages, Optimization Score, or vanity diagnostics in isolation.
- Prefer fewer deliberate changes with clear evidence over continuous micro-tuning.
- If the business context changed, refresh the strategy before tuning the account like nothing changed.
